regions.today: It will be warm and dry this evening with sunny spells, the best of these in the south and east of the province, in light or moderate south to southeasterly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with variable cloud and clear spells. A few patches of mist and fog are possible around dawn. Another mild and muggy night with lowest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees in a light southerly or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Thursday, will be another very warm and humid day with sunny spells. It will be dry in the morning but scattered showers, some possibly heavy or thundery, may develop in the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 23 to 29 degrees in a light or moderate southwest to westerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Thursday and Friday.
